audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 is defensible against a 57.14% win rate on a small sample; the lane is Lillia's until Vladimir's second AP item, which the prose already says.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, and never gives Sanguine Pool's cooldown despite building the whole matchup around it.
audit.why: Riot text on Tides of Blood: 'deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units' — a minion between you and Vladimir eats the poke entirely. Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s, 2 seconds untargetable, 350 range, and costs health rather than mana, so the only limiter is the cooldown. Transfusion is 600 range at 0 mana on 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s. Hemoplague is a flat 120s that amplifies damage taken and heals him per champion hit.
audit.corrected: Minion-block on his E and the 16-28s pool window now stated; pool named as the answer to the R sleep.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'bait it before you spend your kill window' with no duration attached.
audit.why: 28s at rank 1 is the single largest punish window in this lane and the page left it as a feeling.
audit.corrected: Stated as 28s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Vlad has one of the worst level 1s, but with only Q so do you — deny last-hits and set the lane up.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget passive move speed for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 28/25/22/19/16s of untargetability — bait it, then commit; it dodges your R sleep outright. - Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so poke him from behind the wave. - Transfusion costs no mana, only a 4.6-9s cooldown.

edits.before: Track Vladimir’s Sanguine Pool: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool: 16-28s, 2s untargetable — it eats your R sleep, so bait it first. Tides of Blood is blocked by units; stand behind the wave.

edits.before: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Pool is 28s at rank 1 — once he spends it you own the next half-minute of this lane.

edits.before: That is Vladimir’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.

edits.after: Pool the moment your R sleep or W lands — 2s untargetable erases both

notes: Vladimir pays health, not mana, for every ability in the kit file (all costs 0), so any 'wait for his mana' style advice would be wrong here — none was present and none was added. Lillia's E derived flags 'terrain' and 'revealsStealth' contradict Riot's Swirlseed text and were not used.
